name: Tug Drive Field
desc:
Increases the fleet's maximum burn level by %s for each ship with a Tug Drive Field, and the fleet's acceleration by %s for the first. Each further one adds %s the previous one's acceleration bonus. Mothballed ships do not count. No effect while %s is active.

A drive field rated to haul a working catch, wide enough to carry the rest of the fleet along.
short: Increases fleet burn level and acceleration while Sustained Burn is off.

name: Salvage Bays
desc:
While this ship is in a battle, enemy fighters it can salvage leave wrecks more often, and the wrecks hold for %s seconds. Its LYNE drones haul them back to the bays. Fighters this ship launches never leave a wreck.

Handling frames and clamp racks for bringing wreckage aboard under fire.
short: LYNE drones salvage enemy fighter wrecks.
